en: Sepia postcard showing the interior of a traditional Romanian peasant room filled with stacked textiles, plates on a high shelf, icons on the wall, wooden benches, a table with a woven cloth, and a cradle. The front bears the printed greeting "Salut din Sibiu!" and a bilingual caption identifying the scene. The reverse has bilingual postal headings, a Romanian orange 50 BANI stamp with cancellation, publisher and printer credits from Hermannstadt (Sibiu), and a collector's stamp.
